A37.name: 龙趸石斑
A37.form: a stout elongated body, a very large head, a large mouth, the lower jaw slightly protruding, small ctenoid scales
A37.fins: a long dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin, large rounded pectoral fins
A37.markings: spots scattered over the head and body
A37.colour: 体褐色或灰褐色，布满暗色斑点

A38.name: 宝石石斑
A38.form: a stout oblong body, a large head, a large mouth, the lower jaw slightly protruding, small ctenoid scales
A38.fins: a long dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin, large rounded pectoral fins
A38.markings: spots scattered over the head and body
A38.colour: 体浅褐色，密布褐色斑点

A39.name: 河鲀
A39.form: a rounded body slightly laterally compressed, the trunk tapering toward the rear, small spines on the skin
A39.fins: small pectoral fins, no pelvic fins, a dorsal fin set far back, a broad tail fin
A39.markings: spots on the body, 4-6 broad transverse bands
A39.colour: 体背茶褐色，具黑斑和4-6条暗褐色宽横纹，体侧下方黄色，腹面白色

A40.name: 翻车鱼
A40.form: a laterally compressed body, nearly circular in side view, a short small head, very small eyes, a blunt rounded snout, a very small mouth, thick lips
A40.fins: short pectoral fins, no pelvic fins, an anal fin opposite and similar in shape to the dorsal fin, no true tail fin, a wavy-edged clavus

A41.name: 角箱鲀
A41.form: a rectangular box-like body, a short deep head square in side view, large eyes set high on the sides, a small low mouth, hexagonal bony plates fused into a body armour, a dorsal ridge projecting slightly outward at the middle, a prominent ventral ridge ending in a long backward-projecting spine, sides concave inward
A41.markings: round spots on the body, spots on the tail fin
A41.colour: 体黄褐色，腹部白色，具褐色圆斑，尾鳍有暗色斑点

A42.name: 斑鰶
A42.form: a laterally compressed elongated oval body, a small mouth with no teeth, a belly keel, no scutes in front of the dorsal fin
A42.fins: the last dorsal fin ray extended into a filament
A42.markings: a large blotch behind the gill cover, spots on the body, a spot above the pectoral fin
A42.colour: 体银灰色，具黑斑，鳃盖后方有一块大黑绿斑，胸鳍上方有一黑斑

A43.name: 日本鳀
A43.form: an elongated slender body slightly laterally compressed, a short blunt snout shorter than the eye, a thin adipose eyelid covering the eye and raised in the middle, a large inferior mouth, the upper jaw longer than the lower, two accessory upper jaws, small teeth on both jaws and the tongue, medium-sized easily shed cycloid scales covering the body except the head, no lateral line
A43.fins: a dorsal fin origin behind and above the pelvic fins near the middle of the body, a narrow long anal fin starting behind and below the dorsal fin, pectoral fins set low on the sides, small pelvic fins, a forked tail fin with two nearly equal lobes
A43.markings: a longitudinal band along the flank
A43.colour: 背部绿色，两侧及腹部银白色，体侧有一条黑色纵带

A44.name: 断崖之王·巨型石斑
A44.form: a stout elongated body, a very large head, a large mouth, the lower jaw slightly protruding, small ctenoid scales
A44.fins: a long dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin, large rounded pectoral fins
A44.markings: spots scattered over the head and body
A44.colour: 体褐色或灰褐色，布满暗色斑点

A45.name: 黑潮之王·蓝鳍金枪
A45.form: a fusiform body, a large head, a medium-sized mouth, small scales on the body, a slender caudal peduncle with three longitudinal ridges on each side
A45.fins: two dorsal fins, small finlets behind the dorsal and anal fins, long pectoral fins, a crescent-shaped tail fin
A45.colour: 体背深蓝色，腹部银白色
